description: This file defines data structures and functions related to Mattermost plugin manifests, including plugin metadata, server and webapp configurations, settings schemas, and validation logic.

classes.name: PluginOption
classes.description: Represents an option for plugin settings, including display name and value.

classes.name: PluginSettingType
classes.description: Enumeration of possible plugin setting types.

classes.name: PluginSetting
classes.description: Defines a configuration setting for a plugin, including key, display name, type, help text, options, and other metadata.

classes.name: PluginSettingsSection
classes.description: A section grouping multiple plugin settings, with optional header, footer, and custom rendering options.

classes.name: PluginSettingsSchema
classes.description: Schema for plugin settings, including global header, footer, and sections.

classes.name: Manifest
classes.description: Main metadata structure for a Mattermost plugin, including id, name, description, URLs, version, server/webapp configs, and settings schema.

classes.name: ManifestServer
classes.description: Configuration for server-side plugin binaries, including executable paths.

classes.name: ManifestWebapp
classes.description: Configuration for web application bundle associated with the plugin.

methods.name: HasClient
methods.description: Checks if the plugin has an associated web client.

methods.name: ClientManifest
methods.description: Returns a client-specific copy of the manifest with adjusted web bundle path.

methods.name: GetExecutableForRuntime
methods.description: Returns the path to the plugin executable for a specific OS and architecture.

methods.name: HasServer
methods.description: Checks if the plugin has server configuration.

methods.name: HasWebapp
methods.description: Checks if the plugin has web app configuration.

methods.name: MeetMinServerVersion
methods.description: Verifies if the server version meets the plugin's minimum required version.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates the plugin settings schema, sections, or individual settings.

methods.name: IsValidPluginId
methods.description: Validates the plugin ID against naming rules.

methods.name: IsValidHTTPURL
methods.description: Validates if a URL is a proper HTTP URL.

methods.name: FindManifest
methods.description: Locates and parses the plugin manifest file (YAML or JSON) in a directory.
